intended_behavior: Add a new alias entry in MODEL_ALIASES dictionary for the new Bedrock Claude 4.5 model, e.g., "claude-sonnet-4-5": "bedrock/global.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929-v1:0", to allow users to refer to the new model using a short alias name, preserving existing aliases.

Ensure that environment variable checks related to Bedrock/Anthropic models include the new Bedrock Claude 4.5 model. This maintains correct validation of required AWS credentials and any Bedrock environment requirements for the new model without affecting existing environment validation.
